name: Cao Dai Holy See
nameVi: Tòa Thánh Cao Đài Tây Ninh
summary: Give the noon service the hour. You walk the courtyard, shoes off, men by the right door and women by the left, and look into the prayer hall. The Bình Dương page allows about 60 minutes. Tây Ninh pages do not print another length. No ticket was printed. Check on arrival. Skip it if you came for Cu Chi, or for incense at a pagoda door.
getThere: About 4 km southeast of the old city, in phường Long Hoa.
heroCaption: The facade, both towers, and the courtyard

notice.title: No ticket is printed
notice.body: None of the temple pages opened print a ticket. Check on arrival.

body: Walk the courtyard and look into the prayer hall at a service. The plan is a dragon-horse. The mountain board prints the hall at 97.5 m by 22 m. The ward page prints twelve carved gates. Noon is the service the provincial card tells you to see. Dress is modest. Shoes come off. Men take the right door. Women take the left door. The other daily services are 0:00, 6:00, and 18:00. The four together are cúng tứ thời. If you are staying, the 18:00 rite is the evening in this same court. On 25 September 2026 the flower procession left at 18:30 and the great rite was at 22:00.

The mountain board says work started in 1931, was completed on 24 January 1947, and was inaugurated on 1 February 1955. The provincial card, the ward page, and the Bình Dương page say work started in 1933. The ward page says the building was completed in 1947 and inaugurated in 1955. The provincial card says the work was finished in 1955. Both 1947 and 1955 stay. The ward page prints grounds of more than 1 km² and nearly 100 ha. The Bình Dương page prints about 1 km². Both stay. The same ward page prints 3,027 stars on the canopy and 3,072 globes.

Chí Tôn day is the 9th of lunar January on the mountain board, and the 8th of lunar January on the ward page, which also says more than 30,000 people. Both days stay. This is the Cao Dai central temple. It is not a Buddhist pagoda, and it is not a wing of the Cu Chi tunnels. The mountain office at khu phố Ninh Phú, phường Bình Minh, is not this door. The hour the grounds close was not printed. Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The prayer hall at a service, with the congregation in white
figures.alt: Worshippers in white inside the Cao Dai Holy See prayer hall

gettingThere: The mountain board puts the temple in phường Long Hoa, about 4 km southeast of the old city. From 1 July 2025 that old city centre is phường Tân Ninh, and clause 90 kept old Long Hoa inside phường Long Hoa. Minutes from Tân Ninh were not printed. Check on arrival. Do not follow the footer address on the mountain board. Khu phố Ninh Phú, phường Bình Minh, is the mountain office.

legs.heading: From Tân Ninh
legs.body: About 4 km southeast, into phường Long Hoa. The minutes are check on arrival. Sleep in Tân Ninh if the noon service and the 18:00 rite are the same day.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: The provincial homepage prints about 100 km. The operator prints about 90 km to more than 100 km from Tân Sơn Nhất to the city centre, and a drive of about 2.5 to 3 hours. The national card’s about 110 km is measured to Ba Den, not to this door. Quốc lộ 22 and the 2018 article’s Quốc lộ 22A then tỉnh lộ 782 both stay. A coach fare and an official station door are check on arrival.

hours: Services at 0:00, 6:00, 12:00, and 18:00. The hour the grounds close was not printed. Check on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed.
admissionNote: None of the temple pages opened print a ticket. Check on arrival. No child rule was printed. The visit length on the Bình Dương page is about 60 minutes. Tây Ninh pages do not print a second length.
